text_parts:
Image A and Image B show the same location at different times.

What changed between these two images?

Identify the most important differences that are directly visible in the two
images. Distinguish persistent physical or structural changes from temporary
or environmental differences such as people, weather, snow, vegetation,
lighting, framing, or image quality when relevant.

Do not infer causes, dates, renovations, or historical events that are not
directly supported by the images. If no meaningful structural change is
visible, say so clearly.

Answer concisely in 2-5 sentences.

message.content: The most significant structural change between these images is the addition of a tall brick smokestack/chimney that appears in Image A but is absent in Image B. The main building with the distinctive tower remains largely the same in both images, maintaining its architectural features and overall structure. The building on the right side also appears consistent between both time periods. Beyond this major addition of the smokestack, the core buildings and their positioning show remarkable persistence across what appears to be a considerable time span.
